{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative sentiment (e.g., -0.25 or 0.50) as it signals downward pressure.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% when recent true outcomes show persistent downward drift from historical highs.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-day average, reduce by 10-15%.",
    "Avoid over-optimistic spikes: if model forecasts a sharp upward move after a dip, cap the peak at 10% above the 14-day moving average.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment history includes multiple consecutive 0.50 values, indicating strong bearish sentiment.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is below forecast by >10% for 3+ consecutive days, adjust next forecast downward by 5-8%.",
    "When sentiment history includes 0.00 for 5+ days, apply a 3% upward bias to counteract potential mean reversion.",
    "If forecast is consistently above true outcome by >15% over 5 days, reduce forecast by 10% and re-evaluate sentiment influence."
  ]
}
